evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the media
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the media" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the media
sections.description: Sets the space between the media and its surroundings on each side: top, right, bottom, and left. Add padding to inset the image or video from the screen edges for a framed look, or set it to zero for a full-bleed, edge-to-edge hero. The theme default is a safe start; adjust only if the media looks too tight or too floaty in preview.
